item.title: Nvidia earnings preview: AI infrastructure, input costs and a $500bn war chest
item.summary: Nvidia reports second-quarter earnings after the US market closes on 26 August, with investors eager for insight into the health of the AI boom and the sustainability of hyperscaler spending. Analysts expect adjusted earnings of $2.09 a share on revenue of $92bn, according to Bloomberg consensus estimates.
